text: According to a Corran Bay municipal bulletin and a statement from the Larkmere Festival Committee, Corran Bay will again host the annual Larkmere kite festival on 18 May, with organizers expecting about 12,000 visitors. The town, known for its wide foreshore and steady coastal winds, has served as the festival’s venue since 2009, said committee chair Nella Pryce. This year’s program will include the traditional dawn launch, a junior design contest, and an evening lantern ascent over the harbour. Harbourmaster Joss Elwin said temporary sailing restrictions will begin at 8 a.m. and remain in force until sunset. Local hotels reported near-full bookings by Tuesday, according to the town tourism office.
